title: selfdef tensor-parallel slice-plan.json (SD-R58 + SD-R60)
description: Per-GPU rank + slice assignment emitted by the tensor-parallel-inference module's apply.sh. Consumed by the (future) TP runtime to know which GPU hosts which rank + slice share. Closes SDD-021 W-1.

schema_version.description: Operator-stable schema version. Major bump on incompatible change.

ranks.description: Total number of tensor-parallel ranks (= GPU count when full split).

slices.description: Per-rank slice assignment. ranks == slices.length when fully split.

share_pct.description: Slice's percentage share of the model. Equal-split → 100 / ranks (rounded down).
